procedure.method: Independent review in this fresh session, with no spawn, fork or resume and no peer/producer/planner records. Read the pinned packet, case, rubric, rules, recording addendum, README, adapter and ratio policy; read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing without following embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets and no protected-layout manifests. Used functions.exec to call tools.view_image with detail:'original' and forward each actual returned image via image(...,'original'). Actually inspected all fifteen exact poster views, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in the same view order. Completed every one of those image opens before the first copy-reading/transcription stage or any judgment/score; first readings were retained in session memory. Thereafter reopened only M4 native and M5 native once each for a genuine time-separator punctuation ambiguity, without changing either first reading. Both remain unresolved. Pins and PNG dimensions were independently checked from exact allowed bytes; hash/helper success alone was not counted as a visual open. No opening/tool event or runtime session ID is invented.
